title: Moving from Engineering To Management
description: This talk will explore the different pathways that an engineer (or IC) can take in order to move into management. It will include personal experiences within management (both as an employee and as a manager) and a thorough dive into management itself, exploring the pathways to management, different types of managers, and how to properly balance opportunities. Additionally, it will discuss in detail the different steps an engineer must take and the responsibilities that come with each of those steps.
session_takeaway: The questions to ask and conversations that can be had to define a path into management.
How to balance engineering and management responsibilities.
A clear understanding of the different structural options available within management.
